seo.name: Vibhor Mathur
seo.home_h1: Vibhor Mathur: creative director for brand films, campaigns and AI-native production
seo.summary: Vibhor Mathur is a creative director and design leader based in Bengaluru, India. He leads Communication Design at Razorpay across Payments, RazorpayX and POS, and before that spent over six years at Grofers (now Blinkit), leaving as Associate Director, Marketing Design. His work spans brand films, integrated campaigns, interactive landing pages and AI-native production, including Trial of the Century, which won Generative AI at the Shorty Awards. Hire him for creative direction, brand film and campaign work, AI-led production, building an in-house design studio, or design mentoring.

services.name: Creative direction for brand films and campaigns
services.desc: Concept, art direction and craft for brand films, launch videos, keynote films and integrated campaigns, from brief to final edit.

services.name: AI-native film and campaign production
services.desc: Fully AI-made films and campaign systems that stay consistent at scale, such as 81 television films for 20 founders with no cameras, sets or lights.

services.name: Interactive landing pages and games
services.desc: Scroll-driven campaign sites and playable games that explain a product by letting people use it.

services.name: In-house design team leadership
services.desc: Hiring, developing and leading creative teams, and setting the visual system, process and tools they work in.

services.name: Custom AI design tools for studios
services.desc: In-house AI tools with real interfaces for cinematography, product imagery, image editing and founder-led campaigns.

services.name: Design mentoring and AI-in-design workshops
services.desc: One-to-one mentoring on ADPList, plus workshops, talks and panels on AI in design and design leadership.
